articles.title: Hyundai becomes first major South Korean company to introduce internal stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on a broader shift by companies exploring stablecoins to move money between international operations more efficiently.

articles.title: Aave rolls out vaults for yield-hungry fintech investors
articles.snippet: Aave's new Stable Vaults product lets wallets, exchanges and payment apps offer yields on stablecoin deposits

articles.title: Crypto Biz: How stablecoins found their niche
articles.snippet: Stablecoins are carving out specialized roles as regulation reshapes the market, while Strategy’s Bitcoin sale and Vanguard’s tokenization push highlight crypto’s evolving financial landscape.

articles.title: Circle Stock Jumps as Stablecoin Issuer Wins Final Federal Banking Charter Approval
articles.snippet: Circle secured final OCC approval to establish a national trust bank, shifting its $73.2 billion stablecoin to a unified federal framework.

articles.title: EU Set to Revise MiCA in 2027 to Cover Foreign Stablecoin Issuers
articles.snippet: Trump's embrace of stablecoins is pushing Brussels to expand its crypto law to non-EU issuers and tokenized payments, EU diplomats say.
